results.title: Robin Petersen joins Polygon as new Group CEO - Polygon Group
results.snippet: We are pleased to announce that Robin Petersen has officially joined Polygon as the new CEO, effective today, January 7, 2025. He succeeds Axel Gränitz, who will soon be leaving the company to pursue other opportunities. [...] > “We are extremely grateful to Axel for his leadership and vision over the last six years, during which Polygon has tripled in size, expanded to 18 countries, and built an industry-leading digital solutions platform. Under Axel’s leadership, Polygon acquired and integrated more than 50 companies to become the international leader in Property Damage Restoration. We wish Axel all the best in his future endeavors as a proven entrepreneur and are pleased that he will remain a long-term shareholder [...] Robin Petersen brings with him more than 25 years of international management experience, including roles as CEO of the Siemens Power Generation Services business in Europe/Africa and COO of Apleona Group, a technical and integrated facility management firm. Most recently, Robin served as COO of IWG plc. He brings with him a proven track record of leading and inspiring large teams in decentralized businesses to improve overall performance, growth, profitability and cash flow.
